'''2018 European Championship''' was the Players Committee European Championship at Zu Den Vier Winden in Bochum, Germany, 21–23 September 2018. [[Emil Wallin]] finished 1st in Day 3.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Bochum, Germany
* '''Dates:''' 21–23 September 2018
* '''Winner:''' [[Emil Wallin]]
